reviews.title: Unexpected paywall
reviews.text: Exercises I used every week are now locked behind a subscription without warning.

reviews.title: 免费训练变少了
reviews.text: 更新以后以前能用的免费训练都要求订阅，进入前也没有说明。

reviews.title: Ad cannot close
reviews.text: After the long ad finishes there is no close button and I have to restart the app.

reviews.title: 广告结束后卡住
reviews.text: 广告播放完仍然停在广告页，返回按钮也没有反应。

reviews.title: Knee preference ignored
reviews.text: I selected avoid knees but the plan still gives me squats and jumping lunges.

reviews.title: 动作限制没有生效
reviews.text: 设置避免手腕承重后，课程里还是出现了多个平板支撑动作。

reviews.title: Useful short sessions
reviews.text: The short routines fit my schedule and the instructions are easy to follow.

reviews.title: 课程节奏不错
reviews.text: 十分钟课程节奏清楚，动作提示也很容易理解。
